key_insight: StepRS-GRPO improves diffusion LLM reasoning by changing the risk sensitivity of GRPO across denoising steps, rather than using one fixed advantage transformation.
engineering_relevance: For practical RLVR training of dLLMs, the method offers a simple way to better allocate learning signal across generation states, improving accuracy, coverage, and diversity without replacing the underlying trainer.
method: Vary the GRPO risk coefficient stepwise across denoising states.
Use a binary-reward analysis showing centered advantages are rescaled in a prompt- and state-dependent way.
Select schedules using capability calibration plus endpoint/interpolation ablations.
evidence_signal: Across multiple dLLM backbones and math reasoning benchmarks, StepRS-GRPO improved pass@1 and pass@k over centered GRPO and increased answer diversity, with gains persisting after RMS matching.
watch_item: Performance depends on choosing a good risk-coefficient schedule, so calibration and ablation-guided tuning may be needed for new backbones or tasks.
paper_title: Exploring More, Reasoning Better: Stepwise Risk-Sensitive GRPO for Diffusion Language Models
